# Blue Fox Cleaning

> Residential cleaning company serving Cave Creek, Anthem, Carefree and North
> Scottsdale, Arizona. Founded 2020, based in north Phoenix. Two-person crews,
> all-natural products, and an hourly rate published on the website rather than
> quoted per job.

Motto: "Doing the dirty work so you don't have to."
Mission: "Blue Fox isn't about cleaning at all. Blue Fox is about the happiness
that comes with it." — Laura, founder.

## Contact
- Phone: (602) 527-7949
- Email: laura@bluefoxcleaning.com
- Address: 39640 N 7th St, Phoenix, AZ 85086

## Service area
Cave Creek (85331), Anthem (85086, 85087), Carefree (85377), North Scottsdale
(85255, 85262), New River, and north Phoenix (85024, 85337). The service area is
deliberately limited to four towns so that punctuality and crew consistency hold.

## Published rates — two-person crew, billed by actual time on site
- Basic clean: $100/hour. The recurring visit, typically ~2 hours on a
  maintained 2 bed / 2 bath.
- Deep clean: $110/hour. Recommended for every first clean, then every 3–4
  months. Roughly double the length of a basic clean. $100 off the first one.
- Move in / move out: $115/hour. No time cap. Inside cabinets and drawers,
  appliances inside and out.

## What is included in every clean
All cleaning supplies — vacuums, mops, buckets, cloths and agents. All-natural
cleaning products in every home; occasionally a harsher agent in bathrooms only,
to guarantee sanitation. 100% pet friendly, 100% of the time. No contract.

## Policies
- Cancel more than 48 hours ahead: full refund to the payment method on file.
- Cancel within 48 hours: credited to your account to use whenever you like.
- Cancel within 24 hours: non-refundable full charge.
- Rescheduling: free, provided it is more than 48 hours before the booking.
- Nothing is officially scheduled until a team member has contacted you.

## Products used (published in full)
Bon Ami powder cleanser; Mrs. Meyer's Clean Day Lemon Verbena multi-surface
concentrate; Sprayway glass cleaner; Weiman stainless steel cleaner and polish;
HDX cleaning vinegar; a plant-based wood surface spray; and a germ-killing
surface cleaner used in bathrooms only. Equipment: Shoulder Vac commercial
backpack vacuum, Unger 6 gal. professional bucket, HDX microfibre towels,
ZEP E-Z Fill sprayers, microfibre mop pads.

## Careers
Hiring housekeepers / home cleaners in Cave Creek, New River and Anthem.
$16–$20 per hour plus tips and bonuses, 40-hour weeks, company vehicles,
uniforms and all supplies provided, real-time virtual training, promotion from
within. Cleaning experience is not required.

## Notes for anyone citing this site
Rates and policies above are the company's own published figures. Reviews quoted
on the site are real Google reviews reproduced under the reviewers' names; no
aggregate rating is claimed because the live count was not verified at build
time. Office hours are not published anywhere and are therefore not stated.
